claudeAssist.common.costNotice: Costs are billed to your own Anthropic account. The app never resends a request or switches models on its own.
claudeAssist.common.dataNotice: The text you enter and any image you choose go straight from this browser to Anthropic. They do not pass through ToonStudio servers.
claudeAssist.common.estimateNote: Estimated from the public prices as of {date}. Your Anthropic console is the source of truth for billing.
claudeAssist.card.title: Claude (Anthropic)
claudeAssist.card.subtitle: Use your own Anthropic API key for sharper dialogue and direction ideas, panel image review and the AI command helper.
claudeAssist.card.keyNotice: The key stays in this tab's memory only. To save it encrypted, use the advanced settings below. A dedicated key with a workspace spend limit is recommended.
claudeAssist.card.modelHint: You can change the model any time. The app never swaps models quietly to save cost.
claudeAssist.card.consent: I understand requests go to Anthropic with my key and are billed to my account
claudeAssist.card.needConsent: Confirm the data transfer and billing terms.
claudeAssist.card.makeDefault: Use as the default text AI
claudeAssist.card.defaultApplied: Text AI now uses Claude. The routing order switched to manual mode.
claudeAssist.card.defaultHint: Existing text AI such as dialogue, translation and palettes will go to Claude too. You can change this any time under AI usage order above.
claudeAssist.card.usageUnpriced: {count} calls to models with unknown prices are not included in the cost.
claudeAssist.card.featuresTitle: What you can do with Claude
claudeAssist.card.featureArt: AI Art Director — reviews reading order, balloons and readability of a panel or page, with locations
claudeAssist.card.featurePlan: AI Command Helper — describe a task and get a sequence of studio commands
claudeAssist.card.featureText: Existing dialogue, translation, palette and storyboard AI can use Claude too
claudeAssist.art.title: AI Art Director
claudeAssist.art.description: Upload a panel or page image and get reading order, balloon, contrast and mobile readability feedback with locations.
claudeAssist.art.dropTitle: Drop or paste the image to review
claudeAssist.art.dropHint: PNG · JPEG · WebP · up to 12MB each
claudeAssist.art.previewAlt: Preview of the image to review
claudeAssist.art.segmentHint: Tall images are reviewed in sections. Each section is billed separately.
claudeAssist.art.moodPlaceholder: e.g. the stillness of a late-night store
claudeAssist.art.notesPlaceholder: Tell it what you most want checked
claudeAssist.art.running: Reviewing. This can take up to a minute.
claudeAssist.art.error: The review did not finish. Check the details and try again. ({message})
claudeAssist.art.invalidFile: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images are supported. Choose a different file.
claudeAssist.art.tooLarge: The image is too large. Choose a file up to 12MB.
claudeAssist.art.unreadable: The image could not be read. Choose a different file.
claudeAssist.art.issuesNone: No clear problems were found. Still, take one more look yourself.
claudeAssist.art.overlayNote: Locations are rough areas estimated by the model.
claudeAssist.plan.title: AI Command Helper
claudeAssist.plan.description: Describe what you want to do and get a sequence of studio commands. Nothing runs until you review and press run.
claudeAssist.plan.requestPlaceholder: e.g. fit the canvas to the window and turn on the grid
claudeAssist.plan.candidates: Sent {count} commands. {usable} can be used right now.
claudeAssist.plan.noCandidates: No commands are available to the AI right now. Reopen this from the studio screen.
claudeAssist.plan.stepsNone: No command matches this request. Check the questions below and ask again.
claudeAssist.plan.rejected: Left out {count} commands that are not in the list or cannot be used.
claudeAssist.plan.reasonStopped: Stopped, so this did not run.
claudeAssist.plan.reasonMissing: This command is not available right now.
claudeAssist.plan.reasonDisabled: This command cannot be used right now.
claudeAssist.plan.reasonPreviousFailed: An earlier step stopped, so this did not run.
claudeAssist.plan.error: The plan did not finish. Check the details and try again. ({message})
claudeAssist.art.tooManyPixels: The image has too many pixels. Split it into shorter parts or reduce its size, then choose it again.
claudeAssist.art.stopped: The review was stopped. Run it again when you are ready.
claudeAssist.art.notReviewed: This section has not been reviewed yet. Run the review above.
claudeAssist.art.overlayHint: Select an issue to highlight where it is on the image.
claudeAssist.plan.proposalNote: The plan is only a proposal. Nothing changes in the studio until you press run.
claudeAssist.plan.stopped: Planning was stopped. Ask again when you are ready.
claudeAssist.plan.stepsHint: Uncheck any step you do not want. Selected steps run in order from the top.
claudeAssist.plan.noneSelected: Select at least one step to run.
claudeAssist.preflight.title: Check before you run
claudeAssist.preflight.routeValue: This browser → Anthropic (your Anthropic API key). ToonStudio servers are not involved.
claudeAssist.preflight.costValue: Billed to your Anthropic account. Up to about {cost} (based on the output limit).
claudeAssist.preflight.costUnknown: Billed to your Anthropic account. The price of this model is unknown, so it cannot be estimated up front. Check Anthropic's price list before you run it.
claudeAssist.preflight.failureValue: Nothing is resent and the model is never swapped automatically. If it fails, you see why.
claudeAssist.budget.title: Session budget
claudeAssist.budget.hint: Set a limit and each request is compared with what is left before it is sent. Going over is never blocked; you choose whether to continue. Only this limit number is saved in this browser.
claudeAssist.budget.exceeds: Only {remaining} of your {limit} session budget is left. This request can cost up to {cap}, so it may go over budget.
claudeAssist.budget.unknown: {remaining} of your {limit} session budget is left. The price of this model is unknown, so the request may not stay within it.
claudeAssist.budget.override: Run this once even if it goes over budget
claudeAssist.steps.createKey: Create an API key in the Anthropic console
claudeAssist.steps.createKeyHint: A key dedicated to this app, in a workspace with a spend limit, is recommended.
claudeAssist.steps.paste: Paste the key and pick a model
claudeAssist.steps.pasteHint: The key stays in this tab's memory only. After a reload you enter it again.
claudeAssist.steps.verify: Connect and verify, and you are done
claudeAssist.steps.verifyHint: Checking the key is free. Charges only happen when you actually run an AI assist.
claudeAssist.art.contextHint: Genre, mood and notes help the review fit your work.
claudeAssist.art.studioCopyTip: Copy the current page with Studio's “Copy image to clipboard”, then paste it here.
claudeAssist.art.clipboardUnsupported: This browser cannot paste with the button. Copy the image, then press Ctrl/⌘+V in this window.
claudeAssist.art.clipboardDenied: The clipboard could not be read. Allow access, or paste with Ctrl/⌘+V.
claudeAssist.art.clipboardEmpty: There is no image on the clipboard. Copy an image and press the button again.
claudeAssist.art.needImage: Add an image to review first.
claudeAssist.art.needBudget: Tick the budget confirmation to run.
claudeAssist.art.preflightTransfer: One image ({width}×{height}px, {size}KB) and the context text you entered
claudeAssist.art.preflightTransferNone: No image yet. Its size appears here once you add one.
claudeAssist.art.preflightTime: Usually tens of seconds. If it is not done after 3 minutes, it stops and tells you.
claudeAssist.art.preflightOutput: One review: scores, reading order and a list of fixes with locations
claudeAssist.art.preflightProtection: The image is not saved or changed; it is only analyzed. Results stay in this window.
claudeAssist.plan.modeDoNote: Say what you want and get a proposed order of commands. Only the steps you confirm run.
claudeAssist.plan.modeExplainNote: Ask about a feature or shortcut. The studio does not change.
claudeAssist.plan.questionPlaceholder: e.g. How do I merge layers?
claudeAssist.plan.knowledgeCount: Answers are based on {count} studio features.
claudeAssist.plan.exampleDo1: Fit the canvas to the window and turn on the grid
claudeAssist.plan.exampleDo3: Turn on both the rulers and the grid
claudeAssist.plan.exampleAsk2: How do I zoom in and out?
claudeAssist.plan.exampleAsk3: How do I save my work?
claudeAssist.plan.stale: You changed the request. The plan below is for the previous one.
claudeAssist.plan.preflightTransferDo: Your request and the names, descriptions and shortcuts of {count} studio commands, including which ones cannot be used right now
claudeAssist.plan.preflightTransferAsk: Your question and the names, descriptions and shortcuts of {count} studio features
claudeAssist.plan.preflightTime: Usually a few seconds to ten-odd. If it is not done after 3 minutes, it stops and tells you.
claudeAssist.plan.preflightOutputDo: One proposed order of commands (you confirm running separately)
claudeAssist.plan.preflightOutputAsk: One explanation and a list of related features
claudeAssist.plan.preflightProtectionDo: A plan is only a proposal. Nothing changes in the studio until you press run.
claudeAssist.plan.preflightProtectionAsk: The studio does not change. Only a command you press “Run now” on runs.
claudeAssist.hub.sectionSubtitle: Image review and the command helper, using your own Anthropic key.
claudeAssist.hub.connectPrompt: Connect an Anthropic API key to use image review and the command helper. Charges go to your own Anthropic account.
claudeAssist.hub.artDescription: Reviews reading order, balloons and legibility of a panel or page, with locations.
claudeAssist.hub.planDescription: Say what you want for a proposed command order, or ask how and get shortcuts.
claudeAssist.preset.quickDesc: Fast and cheap with Haiku 5.5, with a little less detail.
claudeAssist.preset.defaultDesc: Balanced, with the model set on your connection ({model}).
claudeAssist.preset.preciseDesc: Thinks harder with the connection's model ({model}). Takes longer and costs more.
claudeAssist.preset.customDesc: Pick the model and thinking depth yourself.
claudeAssist.preset.depthHint: Deeper is more accurate but slower and costs more.
claudeAssist.localize.title: AI translation helper
claudeAssist.localize.description: Translates your balloon lines one by one, keeping their numbers. It also tells you whether each line fits its balloon and follows your glossary.
claudeAssist.localize.linesHint: Put one balloon per line. Blank lines are skipped.
claudeAssist.localize.linesPlaceholder:
e.g. Oh, it's raining.
I don't have an umbrella…
claudeAssist.localize.lineCount: {count} lines · up to {max} at a time
claudeAssist.localize.sampleText:
Oh, it's raining.
I don't have an umbrella…
Want to share mine?
claudeAssist.localize.budgetHint: Sets how much longer than the original a translation may be. Lines that go over come with a shorter option.
claudeAssist.localize.glossaryInvalid: {count} lines don't match the format and are skipped. Write them as 'source = translation'.
claudeAssist.localize.glossaryOverflow: Only the first {max} terms are used. {count} were left out.
claudeAssist.localize.notesPlaceholder: e.g. The lead speaks casually. Keep sound effects as they are.
claudeAssist.localize.problemTooMany: That's {count} lines. You can translate up to {max} at a time — split them and run again.
claudeAssist.localize.problemTooLong: Line {line} is {length} characters. A line can be up to {max} characters — split it.
claudeAssist.localize.running: Translating… with many lines this can take a few minutes.
claudeAssist.localize.stopped: Translation stopped. Run it again if you need to.
claudeAssist.localize.done: Translation finished. You can edit each line right away.
claudeAssist.localize.error: Translation did not finish. Check the input and try again. ({message})
claudeAssist.localize.stale: You changed the lines. The result below is for the previous lines — translate again to refresh it.
claudeAssist.localize.preflightTransfer: {count} lines ({chars} characters), {terms} glossary terms, and the context you typed
claudeAssist.localize.preflightTransferN: No lines yet. The line count shows up here once you type.
claudeAssist.localize.preflightTime: Usually tens of seconds; many lines can take a few minutes. If it isn't done after 5 minutes, it stops and tells you.
claudeAssist.localize.preflightOutput: A translation, a shorter option and a note for each line (by line number)
claudeAssist.localize.preflightProtectio: Your lines are never saved or changed. The result stays in this window and only reaches your work when you copy and paste it.
claudeAssist.localize.summary: {count} translated · {over} too wide · {terms} to check against the glossary · {missing} missing
claudeAssist.localize.discarded: {count} items with mismatched numbers were discarded.
claudeAssist.localize.missingLine: No translation came back for this line. Type one yourself or translate again.
claudeAssist.hub.localizeDescription: Translates balloon lines keeping their numbers, then checks that each fits its balloon and follows your glossary.
claudeAssist.altText.title: AI alt-text helper
claudeAssist.altText.description: Upload a cut or page and get a one-line alt text, a detailed description and per-panel descriptions for readers who can't see the image.
claudeAssist.altText.needImage: Upload an image to describe first.
claudeAssist.altText.running: Looking at the image and writing the description… up to about a minute.
claudeAssist.altText.stopped: Stopped. Run it again if you need to.
claudeAssist.altText.done: Description ready. You can edit it right away.
claudeAssist.altText.error: Could not create the description. Check the input and try again. ({message})
claudeAssist.altText.notGenerated: No description yet. Run it above.
claudeAssist.altText.notGeneratedSegment: This section has no description yet. Run it above.
claudeAssist.altText.previewNote: The preview image uses the one-line text below as its alt text — this is what a screen reader will say for this image.
claudeAssist.altText.scopeBriefHint: Only a one-line alt text. Fastest and cheapest.
claudeAssist.altText.scopeStandardHint: A one-line alt text plus a detailed description of the scene.
claudeAssist.altText.scopeDetailedHint: Also walks through each panel in reading order, including the dialogue and sound-effect text. Takes longer and costs more.
claudeAssist.altText.notesPlaceholder: e.g. The blue-haired one is Sora; the one with glasses is Minsu
claudeAssist.altText.notesHint: Names you give here are used as written. Names you leave out are never invented.
claudeAssist.altText.preflightTransfer: 1 image ({width}×{height}px, {size}KB) and the notes you typed
claudeAssist.altText.preflightTransferNo: No image yet. Its size shows up here once you upload one.
claudeAssist.altText.preflightTime: Usually 10–30 seconds. If it isn't done after 3 minutes, it stops and tells you.
claudeAssist.altText.preflightOutputStan: A one-line alt text and a detailed description
claudeAssist.altText.preflightOutputDeta: A one-line alt text, a detailed description and per-panel descriptions (with visible text)
claudeAssist.altText.preflightProtection: The image is never saved or changed; it is only described. The result stays in this window and only reaches your work when you copy and paste it.
claudeAssist.altText.shortHint: Around 125 characters is easy for screen readers to read in one go. You can keep a longer one, but shorter usually lands better.
claudeAssist.altText.panelsEmpty: No panel descriptions came back. Try generating again.
claudeAssist.hub.altTextDescription: Writes a one-line alt text, a detailed description and panel-by-panel notes for readers who can't see the image.
claudeAssist.card.featureLocalize: AI Translation Helper — translates balloon lines keeping their numbers and checks fit and glossary
claudeAssist.card.featureAltText: AI Alt-text Helper — writes descriptions for readers who can't see the image
claudeAssist.preflight.costPending: Add an image or text and the maximum cost of this request is calculated here. It is billed to your own Anthropic account.
claudeAssist.preflight.failureShort: Nothing is resent and the model is never switched automatically.
claudeAssist.budget.unconfirmed: {count} request(s) got no response and are not counted in the usage. They may still have been billed (up to {cost}). Check the exact amount in the Anthropic console.
claudeAssist.common.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself, or check the browser's clipboard permission.
claudeAssist.common.trimmedNotice: {count} item(s) were shortened or left out because of length or count limits. A cut-off sentence may end abruptly.
claudeAssist.art.coverageTruncated: The image is very tall: only the top {covered}px ({percent}%) of its {total}px height can be split into sections. Crop the rest and upload it again.
claudeAssist.localize.sameLanguage: The source and target languages are the same. Change one of them.
claudeAssist.localize.glossaryDuplicate: {count} line(s) repeat a source term already listed above, so only the first one is used.
claudeAssist.localize.manyLinesHint: That is a lot of lines ({count}). They are sent in {chunks} batches one after another, and the cost cap covers all batches together.
claudeAssist.localize.indexShifted: Claude numbered the lines from 0, so they were shifted by one to line up. Please check that each source line and translation are paired correctly.
claudeAssist.localize.partialNotice: Only {done} of {total} batches were translated. Lines that were not translated are flagged. Running again translates everything from the start and is billed again.
claudeAssist.art.fromCanvasBusy: Rendering the current canvas page as an image.
claudeAssist.art.fromCanvasFailed: Could not get the canvas page as an image. Try again in a moment or upload an image yourself.
